title: IndusInd Platinum Aura Edge credit card

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Insurance benefits include coverage for lost baggage up to ₹1,00,000, delayed baggage up to ₹25,000, loss of passport up to ₹50,000, and lost ticket up to ₹25,000.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, email rupay@newindia.co.in within 30 days of the incident. Ensure to submit all required documents within 60 days of reporting the claim
